She faces the LEFT edge of the photo (the stool is in front of her), so turn both shoes around: the toe of each shoe must point to the LEFT edge of the photo, the same way her knees and the front of her body face, and each heel points to the right, at the back of her foot under the hem. Keep everything else exactly the same: her body, skin, nails, white top, the black pants, both hands, the stool, the kitchen, the light and the framing. No text.

items.prompt: Make ONE new realistic phone photo, tall vertical 9:16, using the 7 images I uploaded as references, in the order below. Image 1 = the real pants from every side (listing photos, black and dark brown). Image 2 = the real hidden side pocket with a phone in it. Image 3 = the real centre-back OQQ circle mark. Image 4 = the real shoe from every side. Image 5 = the real woven VANS side tab. Image 6 = her real body and skin tone (ignore its clothes and room). Image 7 = the real room. SCENE (the inspo's shot): mirror-style photo of her right side, chest to floor, standing beside a black bar stool; her left hand rests on the stool's back with a relaxed grip, whole wrist visible; her right hand at her side. The full leg from waistband to floor is in frame. HER: Grace, exactly the body in image 6: slim build, medium-deep brown skin exactly like image 6 on every bit of skin, long almond nails with white nude polish. Her face is NEVER in frame: the top edge of the frame cuts at her chest. A white ribbed cropped square-neck tank that ends at the top of the waistband, a strip of bare waist showing between them. THE PANTS must match images 1 and 2 exactly, colour for colour: the real OQQ high-waisted wide-leg pants in TRUE BLACK. Smooth matte stretch jersey, solid and opaque (never sheer, nothing shows through), no shine. A wide plain high waistband about a hand wide sitting at her natural waist, no drawstring, no buttons, no belt loops, no fly. One thin stitched seam line runs down the front of each leg from the waistband to the hem. Fitted over the hip and thigh, then wide and straight from the knee down to a full-length hem that covers the top of the shoe and brushes the floor. A hidden tonal pocket sits on the outer side of the hip just under the waistband (image 2). Only the small white round OQQ circle mark at the centre back under the waistband (image 3) when the back shows; no other logos, no ® or ™, no text. ON HER FEET, both feet: the real Vans Premium Authentic low-top in sequin checkerboard (images 4 and 5): black squares covered in black sequins, off-white squares plain canvas, black laces, a small BLACK woven side tab with white VANS letters (image 5), off-white rubber sidewall, gum sole. The hem covers most of each shoe so only the front half and toe cap show. Exactly two shoes, one on each foot, worn the right way round: the toe of each shoe points where her knees and the front of her body point, the heel at the back under the hem. The sequins look like real sequins in daylight: no added sparkles, glints, stars or light effects. FEET DIRECTION: She faces the LEFT edge of the frame (the stool is in front of her): her knees and both toes point to the LEFT edge, both heels point to the right edge. PLACE: the real kitchen in image 7: sage-green kitchen island with a white marble top, black round bar stools, warm oak floor. LIGHT: bright daylight, soft and even, neutral white balance: true black stays black, the brown stays chocolate, no yellow, orange or golden cast, no dark or moody grade. A real phone photo, casual and realistic, vertical 9:16. No text, no captions, no watermark anywhere.

I linked them in the orange cart for you.
